idea-plugin.name: Android Auto Refactor (K2)
idea-plugin.description: Automatically refactors Android UI components by appending a configurable suffix to classes, functions, and properties using semantic PSI-based renaming. Supports Activity, Fragment, Dialog, DialogFragment, BottomSheetDialogFragment. This build targets the Kotlin K2 mode and uses the Kotlin Analysis API directly (no reflection) for property/getter disambiguation and override resolution.

action.description: Automatically refactor Android UI components (K2 Analysis API)
